ms.criteria:
All code-related outputs must be completed and implemented according to any specifications in the corresponding GitHub issues or tickets.
All code changes must be reviewed and approved by designated team members before being merged into the main branch.
Each GitHub issue associated with the milestone must be marked as "closed" or "done" upon completion of the related task.
ms.report:
(1) We have executed the different components of the UTxO RPC spec, verifying and validating the results as indicated in the corresponding issues. It is noted, not all worked immediately and one will see issues were generated (within the milestone issue) and resolved.
(2) We have completed testing against another supported ecosystem service, Dolos, the purpose being to find any problems. Dolos was our baseline. We used the Go SDK from UTxO RPC, which is the Go implementation of the UTxO RPC spec, to test against both Dolos and Cardano Node API.
(3) We have two SDKs, as mentioned, one is provided by https://github.com/utxorpc/go-sdk for the UTxO RPC interface while the other is in this projects repository and is used for the REST interface. 
Issues provide evidenced of code output, documented testing, and (as applicable) code reviews with approvals from a designated team member. 
(4) Our sample application has a public demo on YouTube and is available for anyone to use at app.blinklabs.io 
(5)(6) Corresponding usage documentation has been added and can be found here: https://github.com/blinklabs-io/cardano-node-api. As specified, the external documentation can be found on https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/utxorpc/go-sdk and Cardano Node API can be found on Builder Tools, as seen here: https://developers.cardano.org/tools?tags=golang
(7) Community outreach can be confirmed on YouTube here and Twitter here, even retweeted by @Catalyst_OnX.
All of this can be traced by the GitHub Milestone 4 issues (aka tickets) in our project board, here: https://github.com/orgs/blinklabs-io/projects/9/views/2 All Milestone 4 tickets have been completed and closed.
